CRITICAL Issues (Must Fix)\n\n### 1.1 HelperDelegate.swift:4-22 — No Code Signature Verification (Security Vulnerability)\n**File:** `Sources/PrivilegedHelper/HelperDelegate.swift:7`\n\nThe XPC listener accepts **any** incoming connection without verifying the caller's code signature. HIGH Issues (Should Fix)\n\n### 2.1 ContentView.swift:105-155 — Silent Failure on Delete Errors\n**File:** `Sources/App/ContentView.swift:105-155`\n\nWhen files fail to delete, the error is printed but the user sees \"Successfully moved X items to Trash.\" Deleted files that fail silently include items the user expected removed.\n\n```swift\n} catch {\n    print(\"Failed to trash \\(item.path): \\(error)\")\n    // Continues silently...\n}\n```\n\n**Fix:** Track failures and show an alert listing what could not be deleted.\n\n---\n\n### 2.2 PrivilegedHelperClient.swift:56-76 — Race Condition in Connection Creation\n**File:** `Sources/App/PrivilegedHelperClient.swift:56-76`\n\n`getConnection()` is not thread-safe. Concurrent calls from multiple tasks can create multiple `NSXPCConnection` instances before `connection = conn` executes.\n\n```swift\nprivate func getConnection() -> NSXPCConnection {\n    if let existing = connection {  // Task A checks\n        return existing\n    }\n    // Task B also checks here, sees nil...\n    let conn = NSXPCConnection(...)  // Both create connections\n    connection = conn\n```\n\n**Fix:** Use `actor` isolation or `NSLock` to synchronize connection creation.\n\n---\n\n### 2.3 ContentView.swift:200-217 — File URL Drop Validation Missing\n**File:** `Sources/App/ContentView.swift:207`\n\nThe drop handler accepts any `.app` file extension but doesn't validate it's actually an application bundle or check if it exists.\n\n```swift\nurl.pathExtension == \"app\" else { return }  // Only checks extension\n```\n\n**Fix:** Add `url.pathExtension == \"app\" && FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path)` or verify the bundle structure.\n\n---\n\n### 2.4 FileScanner.swift:38-58 — No Timeout on Large Directory Enumeration\n**File:** `Sources/App/FileScanner.swift:38-58`\n\n`searchDirectory` enumerates `/Library` and `/Applications` which can be very large. This can hang the UI for seconds. The `options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]` helps but doesn't prevent slow enumeration.\n\n**Fix:** Add a semaphore or task timeout, or limit depth/enumeration time.\n\n---\n\n## 3.
